text.text:
### Prerequisites

This text puts into practice the multiplication analyzed in the previous text (<htcite0>). Some exercises advance an order with the complement, as presented in **Advancing an Order and the Complement** (<htcite1>). We recommend studying both texts before proceeding.

### The Abacus (Multiplication)

#### The abacus in this section

As soon as the page loads, the abacus is initialized with a multiplication problem: a two-digit number (10 to 99) multiplied by a one-digit number (1 to 9).

Follow each instruction that the abacus above displays until the calculation is complete; the "🎲 New Exercise" button starts another problem at the same level.

After you finish the 9th level, you will receive the following message: "🏅 Congratulations! You reached the last level! 🏅"
